messages:
maria: quick check — I'm about to land a TF change that wires conditional ingress for the payment service overlay in staging/prod. Can someone sanity-check the approach?

samir: what's the high-level change?

maria: we add a bool var `enable_ingress_conditions` per overlay and a small k8s `Ingress` template that toggles path-based routing for legacy routes. TF will set the helm values file via `helm_release` -> `values` map.

olga: is this for canary traffic steering or just cleanup for the new gateway?

maria: mostly cleanup + a fallback for the gateway migration. In staging I want `enable_ingress_conditions = true` so we route /v1/payments to new backend, /v1/payments/legacy to legacy for a week. In prod default stays false until canary done.

derrick: watch secrets wiring — helm value expects `secretName: payments-certs-{{ .Values.env }}` and the TF plan shows creating a new secret path. Are you moving from SSM to SecretsManager?

maria: yes moving to SecretsManager for certs. TF will create `aws_secretsmanager_secret_version` with encrypted blob. I'll add cross-account KMS alias check.

samir: can you paste the helm snippet you're going to render?

maria: sure:

```
# templates/ingress-conditional.yaml
{{- if .Values.enableIngressConditions }}
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: payments-conditional
spec:
  rules:
    - http:
        paths:
          - path: /v1/payments/legacy
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: payments-legacy
                port:
                  number: 80
          - path: /v1/payments
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: payments
                port:
                  number: 80
{{- end }}
```

toni: looks ok. Two things: 1) make sure the ingress class and TLS are conditional too, otherwise staging will try to mount prod certs; 2) TF plan should include data lookup of the secret ARN, don't create duplicate secrets.

maria: good call — I'll gate TLS by `enable_tls` and pass `tlsSecretName` in values instead of hardcoding. Also I'll add a `data "aws_secretsmanager_secret"` lookup to reference existing.

infra-bot: note: staging deploy window 21:00 UTC — any infra changes that touch secrets must be approved by security before that window.

olga: does the plan need any RBAC changes? ingress controller needs permission to read secrets in the namespace if using `Secret` for TLS.

maria: helm will mount the secret as `tls: - secretName: {{ .Values.tlsSecretName }}` — k8s will require the secret obj in the namespace. TF will create it in staging namespace via `kubernetes_secret` referencing the decoded blob. For prod, we'll skip creation and set `tlsSecretName` to the existing secret.

derrick: quick ping for terraform reviewers: @samir @olga can you take a look at the plan when ready? I want to catch cross-account KMS and secret ARN drift.

samir: will do. small nit — avoid using `for_each` on a resource that may be empty; it causes destroy/create noise. Use conditional `count` pattern we use in overlays repo.

maria: noted. I'll update to `count = var.enable_tls ? 1 : 0` for the `kubernetes_secret` resource.

toni: also add a canary toggle in the values: `ingress.canary: true/false` so routing can be flipped without redeploying helm chart.

maria: good idea — I'll add `ingress.canary` and wire it to annotations `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/canary: "true"` when enabled.

samir: last ask — attach the TF plan output in the PR (redact ARNs if needed) and link to the kustomize helm overlay diff. Helps release-gate folks.

maria: will do. plan to open PR in ~30m, target staging promote after approvals. Thanks all :thumbsup:
